scripts.test:frontend: vitest run --coverage || (echo '[FAIL] Backend coverage below threshold' && exit 1)
scripts.test:backend: cd .. && cd services/nyaa-service && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo llvm-cov -q --fail-under-lines 99 --fail-under-functions 99 --fail-under-regions 99 || (echo '[FAIL] Backend coverage below threshold' && exit 1)
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test --reporter=line || (echo '[FAIL] Playwright tests failed' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . || (echo '[FAIL] Biome lint failed' && exit 1)
